title: Continuity of a map into a space carrying the initial topology of a family of maps
statement: Let $X$ be a set, let $(Y_i)_{i\in I}$ be topological spaces and $q_i:X\to Y_i$ maps, and give $X$ the coarsest topology for which every $q_i$ is continuous (the topology with subbase the sets $q_i^{-1}(V)$, $i\in I$, $V\subseteq Y_i$ open). Let $T$ be a topological space and $g:T\to X$ a map. Then $g$ is continuous if and only if $q_i\circ g:T\to Y_i$ is continuous for every $i\in I$.
